g.text: Color space standardization • Pixel value normalization to [0, 1] • Grayscale conversion for texture
• Extracted across H, S, V channels
Unified early-fusion descriptor combining colour & texture attributes
f = [ fcolour (9-D) ∥ ftexture (4-D) ] ∈ ℝ13 (13-dimensional joint representation)
Feature re-scaling to [0, 1] per dimension using offline gallery statistics
Query-adaptive weight inference trained offline via Triplet Margin Loss
Output: wC = Softmax(z)1, wT = Softmax(z)2 such that wC + wT = 1.0, (wC, wT ≥ 0)
Adaptive query-dependent Euclidean distance between query Iq and gallery image Ig
D(Iq, Ig) = √ [ wC · ∥f̂colour(q) - f̂colour(g)∥2 + wT · ∥f̂texture(q) - f̂texture(g)∥2 ]
Global gallery sorting by ascending adaptive distance metric
Evaluated via Precision@10, Recall@10, F1-Score@10, and Mean Average Precision (mAP)
Corel-1K evaluation: Peak retrieval performance (mAP = 0.4845, +12.9% relative gain)
